shortDescription: Configuration for OAuth Identity Provider (IdP) profile resource.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: attributes
options.description: Name-Value pairs of attributes to be inserted in idtoken. Configuration format is name=value_expr@@@name2=value2_expr@@@. '@@@' is used as delimiter between Name-Value pairs. name is a literal string whose value is 127 characters and does not contain '=' character. Value is advanced policy expression terminated by @@@ delimiter. Last value need not contain the delimiter.

options.name: audience
options.description: Audience for which token is being sent by Citrix ADC IdP. This is typically entity name or url that represents the recipient

options.name: clientid
options.description: Unique identity of the relying party requesting for authentication.

options.name: clientsecret
options.description: Unique secret string to authorize relying party at authorization server.

options.name: configservice
options.description: Name of the entity that is used to obtain configuration for the current authentication request. It is used only in Citrix Cloud.

options.name: defaultauthenticationgroup
options.description: This group will be part of AAA session's internal group list. This will be helpful to admin in Nfactor flow to decide right AAA configuration for Relaying Party. In authentication policy AAA.USER.IS_MEMBER_OF("<default_auth_group>")  is way to use this feature.

options.name: encrypttoken
options.description: Option to encrypt token when Citrix ADC IDP sends one.

options.name: issuer
options.description: The name to be used in requests sent from	Citrix ADC to IdP to uniquely identify Citrix ADC.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the new OAuth Identity Provider (IdP) single sign-on profile. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after an action is created.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: redirecturl
options.description: URL endpoint on relying party to which the OAuth token is to be sent.

options.name: refreshinterval
options.description: Interval at which Relying Party metadata is refreshed.

options.name: relyingpartymetadataurl
options.description: This is the endpoint at which Citrix ADC IdP can get details about Relying Party (RP) being configured. Metadata response should include endpoints for jwks_uri for RP public key(s).

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sendpassword
options.description: Option to send encrypted password in idtoken.

options.name: signaturealg
options.description: Algorithm to be used to sign OpenID tokens.

options.name: signatureservice
options.description: Name of the service in cloud used to sign the data. This is applicable only if signature if offloaded to cloud.

options.name: skewtime
options.description: This option specifies the duration for which the token sent by Citrix ADC IdP is valid. For example, if skewTime is 10, then token would be valid from (current time - 10) min to (current time + 10) min, ie 20min in all.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
